state.question: A one-dimensional quantum harmonic oscillator of mass m and angular frequency omega starts in its ground state. Its frequency is suddenly doubled to 2*omega without changing m. Immediately afterwards its energy is measured. What is the probability of obtaining the NEW ground-state energy hbar*omega?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
